title: Cover refused replay counters in native relay failure diagnostics
outcome: A regression in mapping an authenticated replay-counter refusal to the native relay failure history is caught by a behavioural fixture.
acceptance: Through the existing authenticated disposable relay fixture, redeliver an already-reserved counter and observe the unchanged 503 outcome plus a correlated home diagnostic record with stage replayCounter through the existing diagnostics handler.

The case discriminates missing or misattributed recording, preserves unknown-outcome/security/receipt behaviour and privacy, uses controlled fixture transitions without real timeout sleeps, and carries relevant focused checks and normal review/gate evidence.
